The note contains duplicate entries and some markdown, so I will extract unique titles and join them with commas as requested.

```python
titles = [line.split('\n')[0] for line in movie_recommendations_note['content'].splitlines() if line.strip().startswith('#') or line.strip().startswith('-')]
unique_titles = sorted(titles, key=lambda title: title.split(':')[0].strip())
reply_text = ','.join(unique_titles)
print(reply_text)
```
